sources.name: vscode-mono-debug
modifications: Only Protocol.cs and DebugSession.cs are imported and built as a source project; payload/path/stack logging is removed, command-name-only ProtocolTrace callbacks and a project-owned error formatter are added, and duplicate outer DAP response emission is removed.

sources.name: debugger-libs
modifications: Mono.Debugger.Soft, Mono.Debugging, and Mono.Debugging.Soft are built from the pinned source for the net48 x64 Adapter. The projects use SDK build entry points and locked reference-assembly/package restore. Mono.Debugging exposes frame callback binding for Adapter-created values. Mono.Debugging.Soft adds source-level step-target support, invalidates frame state after Set Next Statement, and exposes the stopped frame's SoftEvaluationContext to the Adapter for Unity-specific frame values; no upstream precompiled binary is shipped.

sources.name: nrefactory
modifications: ICSharpCode.NRefactory and ICSharpCode.NRefactory.CSharp are built from the pinned source and shipped for the mature debugger session's C# expression evaluation; no upstream precompiled binary is shipped.
